review_outcome: Admission-ready for one new physical campus. The round39 locator gap is closed by a new primary route: the proponent's statutory EC compliance report, dated May 27 and uploaded to PARIVESH on May 30, reports excavation in progress.

lifecycle_review.route: Public PARIVESH compliance endpoints: getPublicDataByProposal lists compliance reports for a proposal, previousCompliance returns upload dates and remarks, and getAllDocs with compliance_report_id returns the DMS document links. No login, token or form submission.
lifecycle_review.finding: The signed cover letter dated 27.05.2026 submits the current status of construction work. Item 12 records actual commencement on 30.04.2026 and planned completion in July 2028. The present-status table reports excavation work in progress on Building 1 and excavation started on Building 2, with Buildings 3-6 and ancillary structures not yet started.
lifecycle_review.date_semantics: The nominal reporting period is October 2025 to March 2026, but the report's April commencement date and April spending show the status table speaks as of the letter. May 27 is therefore selected as a publication-normalized document date, not an inspection day. The May 30 portal upload is also inside the window.
lifecycle_review.predecessor: The December 2025 compliance report's listing remark states that construction had not started, which brackets the start between December 2025 and the April 30 reported commencement.
lifecycle_review.scope: Broad project under_construction only. Excavation is not normalized as a finer stage, and no completion percentage, building count in service, capacity or operation is inferred.
lifecycle_review.successor_review: Bounded searches of Amazon's own India pages, the PARIVESH proposal and compliance listings, and dated regional reporting through August 20 found no completion, opening, withdrawal, cancellation or legally effective stop order. The proposal record remains EC Granted.
lifecycle_review.opposition_context: A captured August 19 local report (newsband.in, sha256 ab490bb5b628a1444072e524a09f94d69a119d490ea9f214a6ad99d8e6c391ab) describes residents asking a state minister to relocate the under-construction centre and his undertaking to raise it with the Chief Minister. The research lane also reported uncaptured July coverage of protests and a claimed stall; it is not relied on. None of this is a completion, cancellation or legal stop, and none is selected; a later relocation or halt would require a versioned successor review.
lifecycle_review.absence_limit: Bounded original-source review, not an exhaustive permit, court or site-inspection audit.

identity_review.legal_entity: Amazon Data Services India Private Limited
identity_review.bridge: The status report, the public proposal record, the compliance listing and the CAF lookup all carry the same proposal number, project name and legal entity. The EC annexure reproduced in the report (PDF page 34, EC page 3 of 14) lists the project-site latitude/longitude extremes, which equal the selected KML polygon's bounds digit for digit.
identity_review.internal_code: The report's filename and the KML document name use BOM074/BOM 74, the operator's internal site code. It is retained as an alias only.
identity_review.operator_page_context: Amazon India's June 29 facts page (captured in round39) describes an upcoming data centre in Thane without naming the villages or reporting completion; it is corroborating context, not needed for the regulator-bound identity, and not selected.
identity_review.pdf_metadata_caveat: The PDF's document-information title names an unrelated residential project, evidently a consultant template; the body identifies only this data-centre EC.
identity_review.clearance_type_caveat: The public proposal record labels the clearance type as an EC application in the violation category. The label is retained verbatim and is not interpreted as a violation finding or a construction date.

independent_geometry_review.recapture: Round39 September 10 capture and the separately named September 25 root recapture are byte-identical. The first September 25 attempt failed at the network layer and is logged without retry under that name.
independent_geometry_review.selected_feature: Placemark index 0, ExtendedData Name 'Site 2', 63-coordinate closed outer ring with no holes. Placemark 2 repeats the identical coordinate string; placemark 1, BOM 74, is a smaller inner polygon.
independent_geometry_review.source_crs: WGS 84 longitude/latitude under the normative KML 2.2 definition; no datum conversion, geocoding, snapping or tracing.
independent_geometry_review.area_caveat: About 5% below the EC's 22.146 ha; no fitting or correction is applied.
independent_geometry_review.display_anchor_method: Planar shoelace centroid of the source ring in source vertex order, recomputed in plain Python and verified inside the ring by the draft validator's own point-in-ring test.
independent_geometry_review.report_point_crosscheck: The report's DMS project point, about 72.98743 E 19.21779 N with no stated datum, lies inside the polygon; it is not selected.
independent_geometry_review.uncertainty_caveat: No source states positional accuracy or survey method; the polygon is a government-hosted proponent locator, not an official boundary, cadastral survey, building footprint or work extent.

nearest_selected_campus.distance_scope: Haversine screening distance between representative points, not a boundary clearance.

distinctness_review.method: Shapely intersection of the complete source polygon with all 189 selected Point, Polygon and MultiPolygon geometries, plus alias screening of every sites.csv and projects.csv row.

visual_review.method: Poppler-rendered complete pages reviewed; layout text extraction used as a cross-check. Page 14 photographs viewed only to confirm the page's role, not as imagery evidence.

rights_and_custody.raw_captures: Ignored local files under tmp/research-round41-root, tmp/research-round41-holds and tmp/research-round39-fresh-gulf-india. Only compact restated facts, hashes, the source polygon's coordinates and attribution are committed.
rights_and_custody.confidentiality_footer: The proponent's report pages carry a confidentiality footer even though the national regulator serves the report publicly. No report prose, table, photograph, signature or contact detail is reproduced; only the dated status facts are restated.
rights_and_custody.licence: No open redistribution licence is asserted for PARIVESH content or the OGC standard.

round41_holds_preserved.candidate: AWS Bharat Future City / HYD-123, Hyderabad
round41_holds_preserved.finding: PARIVESH SIA/TG/INFRA2/562674/2025 (HYD-123, survey numbers 112P, 115P, 116P, 117P and 120P, Hyderabad Green Pharma City) carries a three-polygon KML about 46.7 ha. Its May 25 compliance report says the building permit was not yet obtained. Neither the July 15 operator nor the state release names HYD-123 or those survey numbers, and an older operating Meerkhanpet campus also sits in Pharma City.
round41_holds_preserved.next_step: A primary record naming HYD-123 or its survey numbers for the July 15 ceremony, or HYD-123's next compliance report stating commencement.

round41_holds_preserved.finding: Its June compliance report says the building permit had not been obtained.
Keyless routes found no georeferenced parcel; Korean address and cadastral map services require API keys and were not used. No named OSM feature exists.
Independence broke ground on May 12, before the window; in-window disclosures are portfolio-generic, and the site page is undated with only a road-intersection locality.
